scenario.preconditions: Haxe 4.3.7, reflaxe 4.0.0-beta, an explicit application source root, and native PHP 7.4 or newer
scenario.input: ordinary tracer.Main with a static main calling Sys.println with one String literal
scenario.actionOrCompilationPath: Haxe typed AST -> custom Reflaxe registration -> typed PHP IR -> per-type PHP and exact map -> dependency-ordered bootstrap -> php -l -> native PHP execution
scenario.observableResult: the readable Main type artifact and separate bootstrap print exactly reflaxe.php typed PHP tracer followed by one newline
scenario.errorOrEdgeBehavior: an unsupported Int value or missing/floating PHP profile fails at its Haxe/configuration boundary and publishes no partial artifact graph
scenario.protectedClaim: first ordinary-Haxe custom compiler tracer only; not broad Haxe, PHP, WordPress, package, or official-suite compatibility

redState.reason: the real compiler registration and driver did not exist

independentOracle: Haxe Sys.println appends a line terminator
manually authored expected per-type PHP, bootstrap.php, and expected.stdout
independent Python source-slice and digest verification
native PHP parser and runtime observation

broaderEvidence.command: python3 scripts/testing/strategy.py validate && python3 scripts/testing/strategy.py self-test

questions: Does the test fail if PHP output, stdout, mappings, or unsupported-AST behavior drift?
Are expected values independent from the implementation under test?
Can application source import backend IR or publish partial output after rejection?
Does the semantic owner select focused, package, WordPress-profile, and full backstop evidence without borrowing their claims?
Does any claim exceed the admitted tracer?
findingsAndDispositions: Generic package branding leaked into the neutral fixture; replaced with reflaxe.php-only text and the isolation gate retained.
Late Reflaxe after-generation diagnostics can print without a failing process; unsupported AST moved to a shared after-typing preflight using Context.error.

Declaring the real Reflaxe dependency exposed three existing null-safety failures in the clean installed-package consumer; fixed with an in-bounds code-unit read and narrowed method-body locals, then retained the package vertical.
The initial map generator digest covered only new driver files; expanded to every Haxe source under the generic reflaxe.php implementation.
The semantic selector did not initially require the new tracer for generic compiler changes; reciprocal ownership and the selector self-test now enforce it.
The original monolithic main.php expectation was replaced by an independently checked per-type artifact, exact map, content-addressed graph, and separate bootstrap under an exact PHP profile.
remainingRisks: typed-AST lowering intentionally supports only the tracer grammar
runtime and standard-library ownership are not implemented
official Haxe-suite active inventory and hosted execution are not implemented
